0022600218.text: The Cavaliers (5-6), who are 1-4 on the road and have lost two straight, visit the Knicks (5-4) for their 12th game of the season, with Cleveland 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2.5 games back. New York, which is 3rd in the Atlantic and 3 games back, has won three straight and sits 5th in the East. Cleveland will be without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), and New York will be without Josh Hart (illness). The Cavaliers lost 109-97 to the Knicks in Cleveland on 2026-11-07, leaving them trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series, and they also lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
